cross_account.description: Producer account creates an aws_ram_resource_share + aws_ram_resource_association for the catalog/database/table, and an aws_ram_principal_association for the consumer account id.
Producer grants DESCRIBE (and SELECT etc. as needed) to the consumer account id - a bare 12-digit principal or IAM ARN in another account.
Consumer creates a resource link: aws_glue_catalog_database with target_database { catalog_id, database_name } pointing at the producer catalog.
Consumer grants local principals on the resource link name - without this grant the link resolves but is unreachable by users.
The underlying S3 location must be registered in the producer's Lake Formation and the consumer role needs S3 access via LF credential vending or bucket policy.
